target.title: Integrations: add ClickClack and Raft channels, five new providers, current stats
target.body:
Audit of /integrations against the current openclaw repo and docs.openclaw.ai. The catalog had drifted since the last refresh (#175): two shipped channels and five documented providers were missing, and two stats were stale.

## Added

**Channels (27 → 29):**
- **ClickClack** — self-hosted ClickClack workspaces via first-class bot tokens (official plugin; logo from the ClickClack repo's own SVG mark).
- **Raft** — Raft External Agents via the Raft CLI wake bridge (official plugin; mark extracted from raft.build's logo SVG, cropped to the glyph and inverted for the dark theme, same compromise the catalog already makes for Urbit/Tlon).

**Provider directory:**
- **ClawRouter** (inference and gateways)
- **Gradium** and **Inworld** (speech synthesis, media group)
- **OpenCode Go** and **Claude Max API proxy** (hosted models)

**Stats:** chat channels 27 → 29 (matches the page's own catalog), provider directory entries 57 → 62 (matches docs.openclaw.ai/providers, excluding the index/overview pages). The two plugin-count stats are left as-is — they come from packaging metadata I couldn't re-derive cheaply, and the current values remain plausible against the 140-odd extension directories in core.

All seven new docs URLs verified live (200). Deliberately skipped: `qa-channel` (repo-internal test transport, docs say "not a production channel") and the BlueBubbles page (it's a migration guide — BlueBubbles support was removed, and the catalog correctly never listed it).

The content-contract test pinning the channel-count stat is updated (27 → 29); the brand-mark test now passes with the two new logos. `bun run build` (20 pages) and `bun test` (23/23) pass; page render verified on the dev server (stats row, ClickClack card, and all five provider links visible).
